tickets.subject: Can't log in after password reset

conversation.content: Hi, I reset my password this morning but now I can't log in. It keeps saying 'invalid credentials'.

I'm sorry you're having trouble. Let me check our knowledge base for you...

Here are some steps to try:
1. Clear your browser cache and cookies
2. Use the 'Forgot Password' link to set a new password
3. Try logging in from a different browser
Still doesn't work. I've tried all of that. This is urgent - I have a deadline today.
